{{Youmay|the [[in-universe]] character|[[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]], the real-world author}}
'''Ryan Kaufman''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] individual who was a [[Translator/Legends|translator]] of the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Kaminoan (language)/Legends|language]] to [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. Kaufman translated a Kaminoan [[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod|myth]] of the [[Magic/Legends|magical]] and powerful [[Deity/Legends|god-beast]] [[Protas]], and both his defeat and [[Death/Legends|death]] due to a [[Unidentified aiwha pod|pod]] of the [[Cetacean/Legends|cetacean]] [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwha]]. The tale served to explain why the aiwha were accorded respect by all creatures in the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the<ref name="tale">{{StoryCite|story=The Tale of the Aiwha Pod (short story)|book=Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Kamino">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="tale" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Translated from the Kaminoan by Ryan Kaufman|Opening of "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="tale" />}}
The real-life author [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] wrote the [[List of short stories|short story]] "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod (short story)|The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide|official game guide]] for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'' in [[2005]]. The story was written from an in-universe perspective, and opened with the words "''Translated from the Kaminoan by Ryan Kaufman''," which placed the author's namesake in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe.<ref name="tale" />
